title: Commit rule: a carried candidate with a byte-identical contribution adopts the earlier review (Greg 2026-11-06)
outcome: The repository's commit-rule text lets a candidate committed afresh on a moved master adopt an earlier review when its contribution is byte-identical. It lands under the authority-text procedure (a)/(b)/(c), with Greg's word recorded verbatim.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md (kept in step) and .claude/commands/review-changes.md state that a candidate committed afresh on a moved master adopts the review of an earlier candidate whose contribution (its diff against its parent) is byte-identical and which has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding; any change to the contribution needs a new review; the full gate still runs on the new candidate; the integration owner still assesses dependencies and conflicts; Greg's word is quoted verbatim with its source.
Engram::Fable's and Termal::Fable2's concurrence on the exact final wording is recorded in this item's notes before landing, and the exact final wording was sent to Greg before landing.
The /review-changes final-diff audit of the exact landed diff is recorded on this item as passed, and the change lands under the standing rule.

completion.summary: The commit rule now lets a candidate committed afresh on a moved master adopt an earlier review pair when its contribution is byte-identical. It landed in master 06e0dbcc under the authority-text procedure.
